items.title: 17.4 Thermal Decomposition of Carbonates and Nitrates (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the thermal decomposition of carbonates and nitrates (PDF 8-10).

blocks.text: Thermal decomposition aisa reaction hai jis mein aik compound garam karne par do ya zyada saada maaddon mein toot'ta hai; bonds torne ke liye aam taur par tawanai chahiye (endothermic). Yeh Group 2 ke carbonates aur nitrates ke mutale mein mufeed hai kyunke un ka thermal istehkaam wazeh rujhan dikhata hai.

items: Carbonates toot kar metal oxide aur carbon dioxide dete hain, maslan MgCO3(s) -> MgO(s) + CO2(g) aur CaCO3(s) -> CaO(s) + CO2(g). In ka istehkaam group mein neeche barhta hai: BeCO3 sab se kam darje par tootta aur BaCO3 ko sab se zyada chahiye.

Nitrates toot kar metal oxide, bhoori nitrogen dioxide aur oxygen dete hain, maslan 2Ca(NO3)2(s) -> 2CaO(s) + 4NO2(g) + O2(g). In ka istehkaam bhi neeche barhta hai: Be(NO3)2 sab se kam aur Ba(NO3)2 sab se zyada mustahkam.

blocks.text: Yeh rujhan polarising power se samjhaya jata hai. Chhote, zyada charge wale cations jaise Be2+ bare carbonate (ya nitrate) ion ko zyada bigarte, us ke bonds kamzor karte hain taa ke woh aasani se toote. Group mein neeche bare cations anion ko kam polarise karte hain, is liye un ke carbonates aur nitrates ko zyada garmi chahiye.

blocks.alt: Do khaake. Oopar: chhota laal Mg2+ ion aur us ke saath carbonate ka hara teen patti wala electron badal (cloud), jis ka ion ki taraf wala hissa ion ki taraf khinch kar dashed bahari lakeer se aage nikal gaya hai. Neeche: bara neela Ba2+ ion, jis ke saath badal taqreeban apni dashed lakeer jaisa hai.
blocks.caption: Mg2+ aur Ba2+ ions se carbonate ion ka polarisation (kitab ke be-number khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dashed lakeer carbonate ion (CO3 2-) ka asal, be-bigra badal hai aur hara hissa asal waqt ka badal. Chhote Mg2+ ki charge density zyada hai, is liye woh badal ko zor se apni taraf kheench kar bigarta (polarise karta) hai; C-O bonds kamzor hote hain aur MgCO3 kam darje (540 C) par toot jata hai. Bara Ba2+ badal ko mushkil se bigarta hai, is liye BaCO3 ko 1360 C chahiye (Table 17.3). Nitrates ke saath bhi yahi hota hai.

blocks.caption: 1 atm par Group 2 carbonates ke tootne ke darje (kitab ka Table 17.3)

blocks.text: Group 2 ke carbonate ya nitrate ke tootne ka darja dekh kar chemists na-maloom compounds pehchanne mein madad le sakte hain; yeh namoona ionic size, charge density aur thermal istehkaam ka taalluq dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: SrCO3 ke thermal decomposition ka mua'adla likhein, aur batayein ke MgCO3 CaCO3 se kam mustahkam kyun hai.
blocks.explanation: SrCO3(s) -> SrO(s) + CO2(g). Mg2+ Ca2+ se chhota hai, is liye zyada charge density rakhta, carbonate ion ko zyada polarise karta aur use kam darje par todne deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Magnesium nitrate aur barium nitrate ke tootne ke mua'adlat likhein. Kaun kam darje par tootta hai?
blocks.explanation: 2Mg(NO3)2 -> 2MgO + 4NO2 + O2 aur 2Ba(NO3)2 -> 2BaO + 4NO2 + O2. Magnesium nitrate kam darje par tootta hai.

items: Thermal istehkaam neeche barhta (BeCO3 250 C se BaCO3 1360 C).
Wajah: chhote cations anion ko zyada polarise karte.
